description: lattice's bindings contract: which of a source's events, on one of its connections, reach one workspace of a tenant, and the trust it lowers them to.

bound_at.description: When it was bound: there is no history before it.
bound_at.title: Bound At

by.description: Who bound it: the operator, or the grantr subject who did, such as ``user:alice``.
by.title: By

connection.description:
The id of the source's connection it binds, such as a tracker's project or an
installation.
connection.title: Connection

options.description: The source's own options, such as a tracker's default labels.

select.description:
What it selects by, in the source's declared selectors, such as ``{"repository":
"acme/api"}``: validated against the source's select schema; empty selects everything.

source.description: The source's name, as its spec names it: ``tracker``, ``alertmanager``, ``forge``.
source.title: Source

tenant_id.description: The tenant whose workspace it reaches.
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

trust.description: The level it lowers the source's to here, never raising it; None keeps the source's.
trust.title: Trust

types.description: The event types it receives; None receives every type the source has.
types.title: Types

title: lattice.bindings 1.0.0
